description: NaLaO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.66 Å. La is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. All La-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent La atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃La₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
